LC & LG Commission Calculator

Recomputes tiered commissions on letters of credit and letters of guarantee and compares the result with the amount a bank charged.

Open demo

The original is an internal tool and is not linked here. The demo re-implements the same calculation for illustration only; its rates have not been checked against the current edition of the fees guide.

The problem

Commissions on letters of credit and guarantees are tiered by amount and by period. Checking a charge on a bank advice means reproducing that arithmetic by hand.

What it does

  • Letters of credit: new issuance, increase in value, extension of validity, other amendments and advising.
  • Tiered opening commission on an L/C: a lower rate above a threshold amount, plus a monthly charge beyond the first three months.
  • Letters of guarantee: an annual rate pro-rated by days (Actual/365) or by months.
  • Optional bank minimum fee, VAT, and a variance check against the amount the bank charged.
  • A reference table of the rates used, which the tool attributes to SAMA’s Fees Guide for Financial Institutions’ Services, and a printable result.
